text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship is finally just 
around the corner.

I want to seize victory with Taiki 
Shuttle's power and speed and claim the 
title of Horse Girl of the Year, but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Revenge, a rematch, a return match! Next 
time, I'll definitely beat Suzuka-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh... That's the spirit, El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, even if you were to defeat 
Suzuka, I will not yield the top spot to 
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Know that the pinnacle of the Japan Cup is 
none other than this Empress's throne—!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"No, that is the perch of the 'Monstrous 
Bird'! I definitely, absolutely will not 
lose!!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
This year's Twinkle Series has been 
seriously exciting.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Grass Wonder, El Condor Pasa, and the 
sprint king, Taiki Shuttle."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
And now, with unstoppable momentum, it's 
Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"After all, since returning from Hong 
Kong, it's been one landslide victory 
after another! And against top-tier 
competition, no less!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If she wins the next Japan Cup, she'll 
undoubtedly be named this year's Umamusume 
of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: What if El Condor Pasa or Air Groove wins?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean... won't the Umamusume who 
won be the one chosen?

Taiki Shuttle has been on a winning streak 
in GⅠ races so far. If she wins the next 
Mile Championship, she will achieve a 
legendary milestone in sprint GⅠs.

"Even so, there seems to be no stopping 
Silence Suzuka's momentum."

In order to seize the glory of "Umamusume 
of the Year," what else must I do, I 
wonder...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Phew... phew~... Hey, I finished a lap 
around the course!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san? ...Wrinkles on your brow. 
Are you unhappy?
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I meant.

text_block_list.text:
I believe in Taiki Shuttle's potential. I 
will never, ever doubt her again.

"That is precisely why... to grasp even a 
sliver of hope, I must think of everything 
within our power."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Weeell... if you're all right, then I'm 
glad!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, excuse me! Trainer, is it okay if I 
head out now?
choice_data_list: Do you have business with me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees, someone called for me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —To Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Suzukaaa!! Sorry to keep you waiting!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Taiki... No, I'm fine. More 
importantly, thank you for coming.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You are welcome♪ So then—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What did you want to talk about, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ......Umm, you see.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Do you remember? Last year's Mile 
Championship...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Running with Suzuka was 
very exciting!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...I can't forget it either.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I can never forget it. It's burned into my 
memory forever.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Taiki... the speed you showed.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I've been chasing after it for so long. 
That speed, that shadow you showed me on 
that day.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I stopped holding back. I just kept 
pushing at top speed. Because I wanted to 
reach your shadow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
However, no matter how long I sprint at 
full speed, I can't reach you. It won't 
fade... your shadow...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why—Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
In the next Mile Championship, I'm 
challenging you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"The Mile Championship?! Suzuka, weren't 
you scheduled to run in the Japan Cup 
next—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No. I hate the thought of just continuing 
to chase your shadow like this...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I want to see what lies beyond. The 
scenery that lies past your speed...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That was all I wanted to say.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Let us meet on the track again, Taiki.

Hearing from Taiki Shuttle that Silence 
Suzuka had declared war on her came as 
quite a shock, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Trainer-san. I've been thinking, 
and――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This isâso big chance!! Am I wrong?!

Silence Suzuka right now is hailed as the 
greatest active Umamusume.

Facing her in a GⅠ race would be nothing 
short of a massive threat...

“Still, if Taiki Shuttle manages to win 
against someone like her—”

“If Taiki Shuttle's power and speed can 
overwrite her ‘unforgettable’ running 
style...!”

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka was more burning than ever. She was 
very on fire.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
To catch up to me, to surpass me... I felt 
your heart's desire loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But—I won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The King of Milers is one-of-a-kind! And 
the Horse Girl of the Year is 
one-of-a-kind too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll fetch it for you, with these legs of 
mine!!

And so, the fate of the Umamusume of the 
Year title was left to be decided in the 
Mile Championship...!!
